<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><script>(function () {
  ['pushState', 'replaceState'].forEach(function (method) {
    var original = history[method];
    history[method] = function () {
      try { return original.apply(history, arguments); } catch (e) { /* opaque origin, ignore */ }
    };
  });
})();</script><base href="about:blank">
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>gn-math</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Play unblocked games including Minecraft versions on GN-Math. Fast, free, no downloads.">
  <style>
    :root {
      --primary: #fc2651;
      --primary-hover: #e91e47;
      --primary-light: rgba(252, 38, 81, 0.1);
      --primary-lighter: rgba(252, 38, 81, 0.05);
      --accent: #8b5cf6;
      --accent-light: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.1);
      --success: #10b981;
      --warning: #f59e0b;
      --text: #1a1a1a;
      --text-muted: #6b7280;
      --text-light: #9ca3af;
      --bg: #ffffff;
      --bg-secondary: #f8fafc;
      --surface: #ffffff;
      --surface-hover: #f1f5f9;
      --border: #e2e8f0;
      --border-light: #f1f5f9;
      --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-glow: 0 0 20px rgba(252, 38, 81, 0.3);
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 20px;
      --gradient-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #fc2651 0%, #e91e47 100%);
      --gradient-accent: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 100%);
      --gradient-surface: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
    }

    .dark-mode {
      --primary: #fc2651;
      --primary-hover: #ff4d75;
      --primary-light: rgba(252, 38, 81, 0.15);
      --primary-lighter: rgba(252, 38, 81, 0.08);
      --accent: #a855f7;
      --accent-light: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      --success: #34d399;
      --warning: #fbbf24;
      --text: #f1f5f9;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      --text-light: #64748b;
      --bg: #0f172a;
      --bg-secondary: #1e293b;
      --surface: #1e293b;
      --surface-hover: #334155;
      --border: #334155;
      --border-light: #475569;
      --glass: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8);
      --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5);
      --shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7);
      --shadow-glow: 0 0 20px rgba(252, 38, 81, 0.4);
      --gradient-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #fc2651 0%, #ff4d75 100%);
      --gradient-accent: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #9333ea 100%);
      --gradient-surface: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b 0%, #334155 100%);
    }

    /* ── theme classes ── */
    body.theme-ocean  { --primary:#3b82f6; --primary-hover:#60a5fa; --primary-light:rgba(59,130,246,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#60a5fa); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(59,130,246,.4); }
    body.theme-emerald{ --primary:#10b981; --primary-hover:#34d399; --primary-light:rgba(16,185,129,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#34d399); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(16,185,129,.4); }
    body.theme-violet { --primary:#8b5cf6; --primary-hover:#a78bfa; --primary-light:rgba(139,92,246,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6,#a78bfa); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,.4); }
    body.theme-sunset { --primary:#f97316; --primary-hover:#fb923c; --primary-light:rgba(249,115,22,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#f97316,#fb923c); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(249,115,22,.4); }
    body.theme-rose   { --primary:#ec4899; --primary-hover:#f472b6; --primary-light:rgba(236,72,153,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#ec4899,#f472b6); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(236,72,153,.4); }
    body.theme-cyan   { --primary:#06b6d4; --primary-hover:#22d3ee; --primary-light:rgba(6,182,212,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#06b6d4,#22d3ee); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(6,182,212,.4); }
    body.theme-amber  { --primary:#f59e0b; --primary-hover:#fbbf24; --primary-light:rgba(245,158,11,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#fbbf24); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(245,158,11,.4); }
    body.theme-red    { --primary:#ef4444; --primary-hover:#f87171; --primary-light:rgba(239,68,68,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#f87171); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(239,68,68,.4); }
    body.theme-lime   { --primary:#84cc16; --primary-hover:#a3e635; --primary-light:rgba(132,204,22,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#84cc16,#a3e635); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(132,204,22,.4); }
    body.theme-teal   { --primary:#14b8a6; --primary-hover:#2dd4bf; --primary-light:rgba(20,184,166,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#14b8a6,#2dd4bf); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(20,184,166,.4); }
    body.theme-sky    { --primary:#0ea5e9; --primary-hover:#38bdf8; --primary-light:rgba(14,165,233,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#0ea5e9,#38bdf8); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(14,165,233,.4); }
    body.theme-indigo { --primary:#6366f1; --primary-hover:#818cf8; --primary-light:rgba(99,102,241,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1,#818cf8); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(99,102,241,.4); }
    body.theme-fuchsia{ --primary:#d946ef; --primary-hover:#e879f9; --primary-light:rgba(217,70,239,.15); --gradient-primary:linear-gradient(135deg,#d946ef,#e879f9); --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(217,70,239,.4); }
    body.theme-navy   { --primary:#172554; --primary-hover:#1e3a8a; --primary-light:rgba(23,37,84,.15); --gradient-primary:#172554; --shadow-glow:0 0 20px rgba(23,37,84,.4); }

    .theme-grid { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.6rem; margin:.5rem 0 1.25rem; }
    .theme-swatch { width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--border); background:var(--sw); cursor:pointer; padding:0; transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease; }
    .theme-swatch:hover { transform:scale(1.12); }
    .theme-swatch.active { border-color:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--sw); }

    * { box-sizing:border-box; }

    body {
      font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Display','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;
      line-height:1.6; margin:0; padding:0;
      background:var(--bg);
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.05) 2px,transparent 2px),
        linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 2px,transparent 2px);
      background-size:75px 75px;
      color:var(--text);
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      font-weight:400;
      -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    }

    /* ── header ── */
    header {
      background:var(--gradient-primary);
      color:white;
      position:sticky; top:0; z-index:100;
      box-shadow:0 6px 24px -6px color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 50%,transparent);
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
      backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
    }
    .header-content {
      max-width:1240px; margin:0 auto;
      padding:.85rem 1.5rem;
      display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1.25rem;
    }
    .logo { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-shrink:0; }
    .logo-text {
      font-size:1.6rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.02em;
      color:white; text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
    }
    .search-container { display:flex; flex:1; max-width:500px; gap:.75rem; }
    #searchBar {
      flex:1; padding:.8rem 1rem;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius:var(--radius);
      background:var(--glass); backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
      color:var(--text); font-size:15px; outline:none;
      transition:all .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    #searchBar:focus {
      background:var(--surface); border-color:transparent;
      box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.4),var(--shadow);
      transform:translateY(-1px); color:var(--text);
    }
    #searchBar::placeholder { color:var(--text-muted); }
    .control-buttons { display:flex; gap:.5rem; }
    .control-buttons button {
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
      color:white; cursor:pointer; padding:0;
      width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:var(--radius);
      display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
      transition:all .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    .control-button img { transition:transform .4s ease; width:24px; height:24px; }
    .control-button:hover img { transform:rotate(40deg); }
    .control-button:hover {
      transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.22); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    }

    /* ── nav tabs ── */
    .nav-tabs {
      background:var(--gradient-primary);
      border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      display:flex; gap:0;
      padding:0 1.5rem;
      max-width:100%;
      overflow-x:auto;
    }
    .nav-tab {
      background:none; border:none; color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);
      font-size:14px; font-weight:600; padding:.6rem 1.25rem;
      cursor:pointer; border-bottom:3px solid transparent;
      transition:all .2s ease; white-space:nowrap;
      font-family:inherit;
    }
    .nav-tab:hover { color:white; }
    .nav-tab.active { color:white; border-bottom-color:white; }

    /* ── main ── */
    main { margin:0 auto; padding:2rem 1rem; padding-bottom:6rem; }

    #container, #featuredZones {
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));
      gap:1.5rem;
    }

    /* ── zone cards ── */
    .zone-item {
      background:var(--gradient-surface);
      border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
      overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer;
      transition:all .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .zone-item:hover { transform:translateY(-8px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl); border-color:var(--primary); }
    .zone-item:hover::before { opacity:1; }
    .zone-item::before {
      content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
      background:var(--primary-light); opacity:0;
      transition:opacity .4s ease; pointer-events:none; z-index:1;
    }
    .zone-item img {
      width:100%; aspect-ratio:1; object-fit:cover; display:block;
      background:var(--border-light);
      transition:filter .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    .zone-item:hover img { filter:brightness(1.06); }
    .zone-item button {
      width:100%; margin:0; padding:.45rem .75rem;
      background:transparent; color:var(--text);
      border:0; border-top:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:0;
      cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:13.5px;
      line-height:1.25; text-align:center;
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      height:2.85rem; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      position:relative; z-index:2;
    }
    .zone-title-text {
      display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical;
      overflow:hidden; width:100%;
    }
    .zone-item:hover button { color:var(--primary); border-top-color:var(--primary); }

    /* ── minecraft version cards ── */
    .mc-grid {
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));
      gap:1rem;
    }
    .mc-card {
      background:var(--gradient-surface);
      border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
      padding:1rem 1rem .75rem;
      display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.6rem;
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
      position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    }
    .mc-card::before {
      content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
      background:var(--primary-light); opacity:0;
      transition:opacity .3s ease; pointer-events:none;
    }
    .mc-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl); border-color:var(--primary); }
    .mc-card:hover::before { opacity:1; }
    .mc-card-name {
      font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text);
      line-height:1.3; word-break:break-word;
      position:relative; z-index:1;
    }
    .mc-wasm-badge {
      display:inline-block; font-size:10px; font-weight:700;
      background:var(--primary-light); color:var(--primary);
      border:1px solid var(--primary-light); border-radius:4px;
      padding:1px 5px; letter-spacing:.04em;
      position:relative; z-index:1;
    }
    .mc-card-actions {
      display:flex; gap:.5rem; margin-top:auto;
      position:relative; z-index:1;
    }
    .mc-btn {
      flex:1; padding:.4rem .5rem;
      background:var(--primary-light);
      border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
      color:var(--primary); font-size:12px; font-weight:700;
      cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit;
      transition:all .2s ease;
    }
    .mc-btn:hover { background:var(--primary); color:white; }
    .mc-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:wait; }
    .mc-btn-blank {
      background:var(--surface-hover);
      color:var(--text-muted);
    }
    .mc-btn-blank:hover { background:var(--border); color:var(--text); }
    .mc-status {
      margin:.75rem 0 1rem;
      font-size:13px; color:var(--text-muted); min-height:18px;
    }
    .mc-loading, .mc-empty {
      padding:2rem; text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:14px;
    }

    /* ── zone viewer (fullscreen iframe) ── */
    #zoneViewer {
      position:fixed; inset:0; background:var(--bg); z-index:1000;
      display:none; flex-direction:column;
      animation:slideInUp .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    @keyframes slideInUp { from{transform:translateY(100%)} to{transform:translateY(0)} }
    .zone-header {
      background:var(--gradient-primary); color:white;
      padding:.4rem 1.5rem;
      display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
      box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .zone-title { flex:1; min-width:0; }
    #zoneName { font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 .25rem; line-height:1.3; }
    #zoneId { display:none; }
    #zoneAuthor { font-size:14px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.8); text-decoration:none; font-weight:500; transition:all .2s ease; }
    #zoneAuthor:hover { color:white; text-decoration:underline; }
    .zone-controls { display:flex; gap:.75rem; }
    .zone-controls button {
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.1); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
      color:white; padding:.625rem 1rem; border-radius:var(--radius);
      cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; font-weight:600;
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
    }
    .zone-controls button:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5); transform:translateY(-1px); }
    #zoneFrame { flex-grow:1; border:none; width:100%; height:100%; }

    /* ── popup ── */
    #popupOverlay {
      position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);
      backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
      display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      z-index:2000; padding:1rem;
      animation:fadeIn .3s ease;
    }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from{opacity:0} to{opacity:1} }
    .popup {
      background:var(--surface); border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl); width:100%; max-width:520px; max-height:80vh;
      overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
      border:1px solid var(--border);
      animation:slideInScale .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
    }
    @keyframes slideInScale { from{transform:scale(.9) translateY(20px);opacity:0} to{transform:scale(1) translateY(0);opacity:1} }
    .popup-header {
      background:var(--gradient-primary); color:white;
      padding:1.25rem 1.5rem;
      display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    }
    #popupTitle { margin:0; font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; }
    #popupClose {
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.1); border:0; color:white;
      font-size:1.25rem; cursor:pointer; padding:.5rem; border-radius:var(--radius);
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); line-height:1;
      width:36px; height:36px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    }
    #popupClose:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.2); transform:scale(1.1); }
    #popupBody { padding:1.5rem; overflow-y:auto; color:var(--text); }
    #popupBody input[type="text"] {
      width:100%; padding:.875rem 1rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem;
      border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius);
      background:var(--bg-secondary); color:var(--text); font-size:15px;
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); outline:none;
    }
    #popupBody input[type="text"]:focus {
      border-color:var(--primary);
      box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 12%,transparent);
      transform:translateY(-1px);
    }

    .settings-button {
      background:var(--gradient-primary); color:white; border:0;
      padding:.875rem 1.5rem; font-size:15px; font-weight:600;
      border-radius:var(--radius); cursor:pointer;
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); min-width:200px; width:100%; text-align:center;
    }
    .settings-button:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }

    .info-button {
      background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:0;
      margin-left:10px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%;
      transition:background-color .2s,transform .2s;
      color:inherit; vertical-align:middle;
    }
    .info-button:hover { background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.1); transform:scale(1.1); }

    /* ── footer ── */
    footer {
      background:var(--bg-secondary); border-top:1px solid var(--border);
      padding:1rem; text-align:center;
      position:fixed; bottom:0; left:0; width:100%; z-index:100;
    }
    .footer-links { display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:2rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
    .footer-links a {
      color:var(--primary); text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; font-size:15px;
      transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
      padding:.5rem 1rem; border-radius:var(--radius);
    }
    .footer-links a:hover { color:var(--primary-hover); background:var(--primary-light); transform:translateY(-1px); }

    /* ── section headers ── */
    .section-summary {
      font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
      display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; padding:.5rem 0;
      list-style:none; color:var(--text);
    }
    .section-summary::before { content:''; width:4px; height:4px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--primary); }

    @media (max-width:768px) {
      .header-content { flex-direction:column; gap:1rem; padding:1rem; }
      .search-container { width:100%; max-width:none; }
      main { padding:1.5rem 1rem; }
      #container, #featuredZones { grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr)); gap:1.25rem; }
      .mc-grid { grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr)); }
    }
    @media (max-width:480px) {
      #container, #featuredZones { grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr)); gap:1rem; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="dark-mode">
  <header>
    <div class="header-content">
      <div class="logo">
        <span class="logo-text">gn-math</span>
      </div>
      <div class="search-container">
        <input type="text" id="searchBar" placeholder="Search zones..." oninput="onSearchInput()">
      </div>
      <div class="control-buttons">
        <button id="settings" class="control-button" title="Settings">
          <!-- gear icon inline SVG so no external img needed -->
          <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="white" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-4 0v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.68 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1 0-4h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 4.68a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 19.4 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 0 4h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"></path>
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- tab nav -->
    <nav class="nav-tabs">
      <button class="nav-tab active" id="tabZones" onclick="switchTab('zones')">Zones</button>
      <button class="nav-tab" id="tabMinecraft" onclick="switchTab('minecraft')">Minecraft</button>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <main id="mainContent">
    <!-- ZONES TAB -->
    <div id="panelZones">
      <details id="featuredZonesWrapper" open="">
        <summary class="section-summary" id="allZonesSummary">Featured Zones</summary>
        <div id="featuredZones" style="margin-top:1rem;"></div>
      </details>
      <br><hr style="border-color:var(--border);"><br>
      <details id="allZonesWrapper" open="">
        <summary class="section-summary" id="allSummary">All Zones</summary>
        <div id="container" style="margin-top:1rem;">Loading...</div>
      </details>
    </div>

    <!-- MINECRAFT TAB -->
    <div id="panelMinecraft" style="display:none;">
      <div style="margin-bottom:1rem;">
        <div class="mc-status" id="mcStatus">Loading versions…</div>
        <div id="mcGrid" class="mc-grid"></div>
        <div id="mcEmpty" class="mc-empty" style="display:none;">No versions match the search.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>

  <!-- zone fullscreen viewer -->
  <div id="zoneViewer">
    <div class="zone-header">
      <div class="zone-title">
        <h2 id="zoneName">zone</h2>
        <button class="info-button" onclick="showZoneInfo()" title="Zone Information">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12" y2="12"></line><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12.01" y2="8"></line>
          </svg>
        </button>
        <span id="zoneId" style="display:none;"></span>
        <a id="zoneAuthor" href="#" target="_blank">by Author</a>
      </div>
      <div class="zone-controls">
        <button onclick="fullscreenZone()">Fullscreen</button>
        <button onclick="aboutBlank()">Open in New Tab</button>
        <button onclick="downloadZone()">Download</button>
        <button onclick="closeZone()">Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <iframe id="zoneFrame"></iframe>
  </div>

  <!-- shared popup -->
  <div id="popupOverlay">
    <div class="popup">
      <div class="popup-header">
        <h3 id="popupTitle">Title</h3>
        <button id="popupClose" onclick="closePopup()">×</button>
      </div>
      <div id="popupBody">Content</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <footer>
    <div class="footer-links">
      <a href="#" onclick="loadDMCA();return false;">DMCA</a>
      <a href="#" onclick="showContact();return false;">Contact</a>
      <a href="#" onclick="loadPrivacy();return false;">Privacy Policy</a>
      <a href="javascript:saveData()">Export Data</a>
      <a href="#" onclick="document.getElementById('importData').click();return false;">Import Data</a>
      <input type="file" id="importData" style="display:none;" onchange="loadData(event)">
    </div>
  </footer>

  <script>
  /* ================================================================
     SHARED STATE
  ================================================================ */
  let currentTab = 'zones';

  function switchTab(tab) {
    currentTab = tab;
    document.getElementById('panelZones').style.display     = tab === 'zones'     ? '' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('panelMinecraft').style.display = tab === 'minecraft' ? '' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('tabZones').classList.toggle('active',     tab === 'zones');
    document.getElementById('tabMinecraft').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'minecraft');
    document.getElementById('searchBar').placeholder =
      tab === 'zones' ? 'Search zones…' : 'Filter versions…';
    // re-filter whichever panel is now visible
    onSearchInput();
  }

  function onSearchInput() {
    if (currentTab === 'zones') filterZones();
    else filterMcVersions();
  }

  /* ================================================================
     ZONES (original gn-math logic, preserved exactly)
  ================================================================ */
  const container      = document.getElementById('container');
  const zoneViewer     = document.getElementById('zoneViewer');
  let   zoneFrame      = document.getElementById('zoneFrame');
  const searchBar      = document.getElementById('searchBar');
  const zonesURL       = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freebuisness/assets@main/zones.json";
  const coverURL       = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freebuisness/covers@main/";
  const htmlURL        = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/freebuisness/html@main/";
  function zoneURL(u) {
    return (u + "").replace("{COVER_URL}", coverURL).replace("{HTML_URL}", htmlURL);
  }
  let zones = [];
  const featuredContainer = document.getElementById('featuredZones');

  function toTitleCase(str) {
    return str.replace(/\w\S*/g, t => t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.substring(1).toLowerCase());
  }

  async function listZones() {
    try {
      const res  = await fetch(zonesURL + "?t=" + Date.now());
      const json = await res.json();
      zones = json;
      zones[0].featured = true;
      sortZones();
      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const id = search.get('id');
      if (id) {
        const zone = zones.find(z => z.id + '' == id + '');
        if (zone) openZone(zone);
      }
      let alltags = [];
      for (const obj of json) {
        if (Array.isArray(obj.special)) alltags.push(...obj.special);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      container.innerHTML = `Error loading zones: ${err}`;
    }
  }

  function sortZones() {
    zones.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    zones.sort((a, b) => (a.id === -1 ? -1 : b.id === -1 ? 1 : 0));
    if (featuredContainer.innerHTML === "") {
      displayFeaturedZones(zones.filter(z => z.featured));
    }
    displayZones(zones);
  }

  function displayFeaturedZones(featuredZones) {
    featuredContainer.innerHTML = "";
    featuredZones.forEach(file => {
      const item = makeZoneItem(file);
      featuredContainer.appendChild(item);
    });
    if (!featuredContainer.innerHTML) {
      featuredContainer.innerHTML = "No featured zones found.";
    } else {
      document.getElementById("allZonesSummary").textContent = `Featured Zones (${featuredZones.length})`;
    }
    lazyLoad('#featuredZones img.lazy-zone-img');
  }

  function displayZones(list) {
    container.innerHTML = "";
    list.forEach(file => {
      container.appendChild(makeZoneItem(file));
    });
    if (!container.innerHTML) {
      container.innerHTML = "No zones found.";
    } else {
      document.getElementById("allSummary").textContent = `All Zones (${list.length})`;
    }
    lazyLoad('img.lazy-zone-img');
  }

  function makeZoneItem(file) {
    const item = document.createElement("div");
    item.className = "zone-item";
    item.onclick = () => openZone(file);
    const img = document.createElement("img");
    img.dataset.src = zoneURL(file.cover);
    img.alt = file.name;
    img.loading = "lazy";
    img.className = "lazy-zone-img";
    item.appendChild(img);
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    const label = document.createElement("span");
    label.className = "zone-title-text";
    label.textContent = file.name;
    btn.appendChild(label);
    btn.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); openZone(file); };
    item.appendChild(btn);
    return item;
  }

  function lazyLoad(selector) {
    const imgs = document.querySelectorAll(selector);
    const obs  = new IntersectionObserver((entries, o) => {
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.isIntersecting && !zoneViewer.hidden) {
          const img = e.target;
          img.src = img.dataset.src;
          img.classList.remove("lazy-zone-img");
          o.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: "100px", threshold: 0.1 });
    imgs.forEach(img => obs.observe(img));
  }

  function filterZones() {
    const query = searchBar.value.toLowerCase();
    const filtered = zones.filter(z => z.name.toLowerCase().includes(query));
    if (query.length) document.getElementById("featuredZonesWrapper").removeAttribute("open");
    displayZones(filtered);
  }

  const BASE_TAG_RE  = /<base\b[^>]*>/i;
  const BASE_HREF_RE = /<base\b[^>]*\bhref\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s">]+))[^>]*>/i;

  function zoneBaseFor(url, html) {
    const folder = url.substring(0, url.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
    let root;
    try { root = new URL(folder, document.baseURI).href; } catch(e) { root = folder; }
    const m = html.match(BASE_HREF_RE);
    const declared = m ? (m[1]!==undefined?m[1]:m[2]!==undefined?m[2]:m[3]) : "";
    if (!declared) return root;
    try { return new URL(declared, root).href; } catch(e) { return root; }
  }

  function injectZoneBase(html, url) {
    const tag = '<base href="' + zoneBaseFor(url, html) + '">';
    if (BASE_TAG_RE.test(html)) return html.replace(BASE_TAG_RE, tag);
    if (/<head[^>]*>/i.test(html)) return html.replace(/<head[^>]*>/i, m => m + tag);
    if (/<html[^>]*>/i.test(html)) return html.replace(/<html[^>]*>/i, m => m + tag);
    return tag + html;
  }

  function openZone(file) {
    if (file.url.startsWith("http")) { window.open(file.url, "_blank"); return; }
    const url = zoneURL(file.url);
    fetch(url + "?t=" + Date.now())
      .then(r => r.text())
      .then(html => {
        if (/ytgame/i.test(html)) {
          document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = file.name;
          const pb = document.getElementById('popupBody');
          pb.contentEditable = false;
          pb.innerHTML = '<p style="margin-top:0;">YouTube Playables only work in their own tab. Opening in a <strong>new tab</strong>.</p>'
            + '<button class="settings-button" id="ytOpenBtn">Open in New Tab</button>';
          document.getElementById('ytOpenBtn').onclick = () => {
            const w = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
            if (!w) { alert("Popup blocked."); return; }
            w.document.open(); w.document.write(injectZoneBase(html, url)); w.document.close();
            closePopup();
          };
          document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "flex";
          return;
        }
        html = injectZoneBase(html, url);
        if (zoneFrame.contentDocument === null) {
          zoneFrame = document.createElement("iframe");
          zoneFrame.id = "zoneFrame";
          zoneViewer.appendChild(zoneFrame);
        }
        zoneFrame.contentDocument.open();
        zoneFrame.contentDocument.write(html);
        zoneFrame.contentDocument.close();
        document.getElementById('zoneName').textContent = file.name;
        document.getElementById('zoneId').textContent   = file.id;
        const a = document.getElementById('zoneAuthor');
        a.textContent = "by " + file.author;
        if (file.authorLink) a.href = file.authorLink; else a.removeAttribute('href');
        zoneViewer.style.display = "flex";
        zoneViewer.hidden = false;
        try {
          const u = new URL(window.location);
          u.searchParams.set('id', file.id);
          history.pushState(null, '', u.toString());
        } catch(e) {}
      })
      .catch(err => alert("Failed to load zone: " + err));
  }

  function aboutBlank() {
    const newWin = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
    const zone   = zones.find(z => z.id + '' === document.getElementById('zoneId').textContent);
    const url    = zoneURL(zone.url);
    fetch(url + "?t=" + Date.now()).then(r => r.text()).then(html => {
      html = injectZoneBase(html, url);
      newWin.document.open(); newWin.document.write(html); newWin.document.close();
    });
  }

  function closeZone() {
    zoneViewer.hidden = false;
    zoneViewer.style.display = "none";
    if (zoneViewer.contains(zoneFrame)) zoneViewer.removeChild(zoneFrame);
    try {
      const u = new URL(window.location);
      u.searchParams.delete('id');
      history.pushState(null, '', u.toString());
    } catch(e) {}
  }

  function downloadZone() {
    const zone = zones.find(z => z.id + '' === document.getElementById('zoneId').textContent);
    const url  = zoneURL(zone.url);
    fetch(url + "?t=" + Date.now()).then(r => r.text()).then(text => {
      const blob = new Blob([injectZoneBase(text, url)], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" });
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = zone.name + ".html";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    });
  }

  function fullscreenZone() {
    const el = zoneFrame;
    (el.requestFullscreen || el.mozRequestFullScreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen || el.msRequestFullscreen || (() => {})).call(el);
  }

  function showZoneInfo() {
    const id     = Number(document.getElementById('zoneId').textContent);
    const idjson = zones.find(a => a.id === id) || {};
    document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = `${idjson.name || 'Zone'} Info`;
    document.getElementById('popupBody').innerHTML = `<p>
      <b>Id</b>: ${id}<br>
      <b>Name</b>: ${idjson.name || ''}<br>
      ${idjson.author     ? `<b>Game Author</b>: ${idjson.author}<br>` : ""}
      ${idjson.authorLink ? `<b>Author Link</b>: <a style="color:#FFFF00;" href="${idjson.authorLink}">${idjson.authorLink}</a><br>` : ""}
      ${idjson.special    ? `<b>Tags</b>: ${idjson.special}<br>` : ""}
    </p>`;
    document.getElementById('popupBody').contentEditable = false;
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "flex";
  }

  /* ================================================================
     MINECRAFT VERSION ENGINE (transplanted from mc page)
  ================================================================ */
  const MC_FALLBACK = [
    "1.0","1.1","1.12.2-wasm","1.12.2","1.13.2-wasm","1.13.2","1.14.4-wasm","1.14.4",
    "1.16.5-wasm","1.16.5","1.17.1-wasm","1.2.3-wasm","1.2.3","1.2.5-wasm","1.2.5",
    "1.20.6-wasm","1.21.11-wasm","1.3.2-wasm","1.4.7-wasm","1.4.7","1.5.2","1.6.4",
    "1.7.10-wasm","1.7.10","1.8.8-wasm","1.8.8","26.1.2-wasm","26.2-wasm","4k",
    "Aero Client","Astra Client 2-1.8.8","Astra Client","EB Client 1.14.4","EB Client 1.8.8",
    "EB Client","Eaglerforge","Eclipse Client","Forge 1.6.4","GX-Client","Huzzium Client",
    "Kozmo Client","Larp Client 1.12.2","Larp Client 1.14.4","Modern Client","Myven Client",
    "Pixel Client","Precision Client","Reflex Client","Resent Client","Shadow Network",
    "The Broken Script 1.8.8","Tuff Client Beta","Tuff Client",
    "alpha-1.0.16_02-wasm","alpha-1.0.1_01","alpha-1.0.4","alpha-1.0.6_03",
    "alpha-1.1.2_01","alpha-1.2.6",
    "beta-1.0.2","beta-1.0","beta-1.1","beta-1.2","beta-1.3-wasm","beta-1.3",
    "beta-1.4","beta-1.5","beta-1.6.4","beta-1.7.3","beta-1.8.1-wasm","beta-1.8.1",
    "beta-1.9-wasm","beta-1.9",
    "classic-0.0.11a-wasm","classic-0.0.12a-03-wasm","classic-0.0.13a-03-wasm",
    "classic-0.0.14a-08-wasm","classic-0.0.15a-wasm","classic-0.0.16a-02-wasm",
    "classic-0.0.17a-wasm","classic-0.0.18a-02-wasm","classic-0.0.19a-06-wasm",
    "classic-0.0.20a-02-wasm","classic-0.0.21a-wasm","classic-0.0.22a-05-wasm",
    "classic-0.0.23a-01-wasm","classic-0.0.24a-03-wasm","classic-0.0.25a-05-wasm",
    "classic-0.3.0-wasm",
    "efi-1.12.2","efi-1.8.8",
    "indev-20100219-wasm","indev-20100223-wasm","indev",
    "infdev-wasm",
    "pre-classic-rd-131655-wasm","pre-classic-rd-132211-wasm","pre-classic-rd-132328-wasm",
    "pre-classic-rd-160052-wasm","pre-classic-rd-161348-wasm"
  ];

  let MC_VERSIONS   = MC_FALLBACK;
  let mcInitialized = false;

  /* IndexedDB cache — identical logic to mc page */
  const MC_DB = "mc-version-cache", MC_STORE = "versions";
  let mcDbPromise = null;

  function mcOpenDB() {
    if (mcDbPromise) return mcDbPromise;
    mcDbPromise = new Promise((res, rej) => {
      try {
        const req = indexedDB.open(MC_DB, 1);
        req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
          if (!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains(MC_STORE))
            req.result.createObjectStore(MC_STORE);
        };
        req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result);
        req.onerror  = () => rej(req.error);
      } catch(e) { rej(e); }
    });
    return mcDbPromise;
  }

  async function mcGetCached(version) {
    try {
      const db = await mcOpenDB();
      return await new Promise((res, rej) => {
        const tx  = db.transaction(MC_STORE, "readonly");
        const req = tx.objectStore(MC_STORE).get(version);
        req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result || null);
        req.onerror   = () => rej(req.error);
      });
    } catch { return null; }
  }

  async function mcSetCached(version, html) {
    try {
      const db = await mcOpenDB();
      await new Promise((res, rej) => {
        const tx = db.transaction(MC_STORE, "readwrite");
        tx.objectStore(MC_STORE).put(html, version);
        tx.oncomplete = () => res();
        tx.onerror    = () => rej(tx.error);
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  function mcEncodePath(name) {
    return name.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/");
  }

  function mcPartURL(version, part) {
    return `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/accountname291203/minecraftvers@main/game/${mcEncodePath(version)}/index.part${part}.html`;
  }

  function mcPlainURL(version) {
    return `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/accountname291203/minecraftvers@main/game/${mcEncodePath(version)}/index.html`;
  }

  async function mcFetchPart(url) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!r.ok) return { ok: false };
      return { ok: true, text: await r.text() };
    } catch { return { ok: false }; }
  }

  async function mcLoadVersion(version, onStatus) {
    onStatus("Checking cache…");
    const cached = await mcGetCached(version);
    if (cached) { onStatus("Loaded from cache."); return cached; }

    onStatus(`Fetching ${version}…`);
    const urls = [1,2,3,4].map(p => mcPartURL(version, p));
    const [results, plain] = await Promise.all([
      Promise.all(urls.map(mcFetchPart)),
      mcFetchPart(mcPlainURL(version))
    ]);

    let combined;
    if (results[0].ok) {
      const parts = [];
      for (const r of results) { if (!r.ok) break; parts.push(r.text); }
      onStatus(`Loaded ${parts.length} part${parts.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`);
      combined = parts.join("");
    } else if (plain.ok) {
      onStatus("Loaded index.html.");
      combined = plain.text;
    } else {
      throw new Error(`No files found for ${version}`);
    }

    await mcSetCached(version, combined);
    return combined;
  }

  /* card rendering */
  function renderMcGrid(list) {
    const grid  = document.getElementById('mcGrid');
    const empty = document.getElementById('mcEmpty');
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    if (!list.length) { empty.style.display = ''; return; }
    empty.style.display = 'none';

    list.forEach(version => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'mc-card';

      const nameEl = document.createElement('div');
      nameEl.className = 'mc-card-name';
      nameEl.textContent = version;
      card.appendChild(nameEl);

      if (version.toLowerCase().endsWith('-wasm')) {
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'mc-wasm-badge';
        badge.textContent = 'WASM';
        card.appendChild(badge);
      }

      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'mc-card-actions';

      const playBtn = document.createElement('button');
      playBtn.className = 'mc-btn';
      playBtn.textContent = 'Play →';
      playBtn.onclick = async () => {
        playBtn.disabled = true;
        blankBtn.disabled = true;
        const originalPlay  = playBtn.textContent;
        playBtn.textContent = 'Loading…';
        try {
          const html = await mcLoadVersion(version, msg => {
            document.getElementById('mcStatus').textContent = msg;
          });
          document.open(); document.write(html); document.close();
        } catch(err) {
          document.getElementById('mcStatus').textContent = 'Error: ' + err.message;
          playBtn.disabled  = false;
          blankBtn.disabled = false;
          playBtn.textContent = originalPlay;
        }
      };

      const blankBtn = document.createElement('button');
      blankBtn.className = 'mc-btn mc-btn-blank';
      blankBtn.textContent = 'New Tab ↗';
      blankBtn.onclick = async () => {
        blankBtn.disabled = true;
        const orig = blankBtn.textContent;
        blankBtn.textContent = 'Opening…';
        try {
          const html = await mcLoadVersion(version, msg => {
            document.getElementById('mcStatus').textContent = msg;
          });
          const win = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");
          if (!win) throw new Error("Popup blocked.");
          win.document.open(); win.document.write(html); win.document.close();
        } catch(err) {
          document.getElementById('mcStatus').textContent = 'Error: ' + err.message;
        } finally {
          blankBtn.disabled = false;
          blankBtn.textContent = orig;
        }
      };

      actions.appendChild(playBtn);
      actions.appendChild(blankBtn);
      card.appendChild(actions);
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function filterMcVersions() {
    const q = searchBar.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    renderMcGrid(q ? MC_VERSIONS.filter(v => v.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : MC_VERSIONS);
  }

  async function initMinecraft() {
    if (mcInitialized) return;
    mcInitialized = true;
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('mcStatus');
    statusEl.textContent = 'Loading versions…';
    renderMcGrid([]);

    try {
      const res  = await fetch("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/accountname291203/minecraftvers@main/version.txt", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("version.txt " + res.status);
      const text = await res.text();
      const live = text.split("\n").map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l && !l.startsWith("#"));
      if (live.length) MC_VERSIONS = live;
      else statusEl.textContent = "version.txt empty — using bundled list.";
    } catch(err) {
      statusEl.textContent = `Couldn't load version list (${err.message}) — using bundled list.`;
    }

    renderMcGrid(MC_VERSIONS);
    if (document.getElementById('mcStatus').textContent === 'Loading versions…')
      document.getElementById('mcStatus').textContent = '';
  }

  /* lazy-init MC tab on first click */
  document.getElementById('tabMinecraft').addEventListener('click', () => {
    initMinecraft();
  }, { once: true });

  /* ================================================================
     SETTINGS + THEME (original gn-math, preserved)
  ================================================================ */
  const THEMES = ["default","ocean","emerald","violet","sunset","rose","cyan","amber","red","lime","teal","sky","indigo","fuchsia","navy"];

  function setTheme(name) {
    if (!THEMES.includes(name)) name = "default";
    THEMES.forEach(t => document.body.classList.remove("theme-" + t));
    if (name !== "default") document.body.classList.add("theme-" + name);
    try { localStorage.setItem("gnTheme", name); } catch(e) {}
    document.querySelectorAll(".theme-swatch").forEach(s =>
      s.classList.toggle("active", s.dataset.themeName === name));
  }

  function hexToRgb(hex) {
    hex = (hex + "").replace("#", "");
    if (hex.length === 3) hex = hex.split("").map(c => c+c).join("");
    const n = parseInt(hex, 16);
    return [(n>>16)&255, (n>>8)&255, n&255];
  }
  function lightenHex(hex, amt) {
    const [r,g,b] = hexToRgb(hex);
    return `rgb(${Math.round(r+(255-r)*amt)},${Math.round(g+(255-g)*amt)},${Math.round(b+(255-b)*amt)})`;
  }
  function setCustomTheme(hex) {
    THEMES.forEach(t => document.body.classList.remove("theme-"+t));
    const [r,g,b] = hexToRgb(hex), hover = lightenHex(hex, .22), s = document.body.style;
    s.setProperty("--primary", hex);
    s.setProperty("--primary-hover", hover);
    s.setProperty("--primary-light", `rgba(${r},${g},${b},.15)`);
    s.setProperty("--primary-lighter", `rgba(${r},${g},${b},.08)`);
    s.setProperty("--gradient-primary", hex);
    s.setProperty("--shadow-glow", `0 0 20px rgba(${r},${g},${b},.4)`);
    try { localStorage.setItem("gnTheme","custom"); localStorage.setItem("gnCustom",hex); } catch(e) {}
    document.querySelectorAll(".theme-swatch").forEach(sw => sw.classList.remove("active"));
    const cs = document.querySelector(".custom-swatch");
    if (cs) { cs.style.setProperty("--sw",hex); cs.classList.add("active"); }
  }

  function darkMode() {
    document.body.classList.toggle("dark-mode");
    try { localStorage.setItem("gnDark", document.body.classList.contains("dark-mode") ? "1" : "0"); } catch(e) {}
  }

  try {
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("gnTheme") || "default";
    if (savedTheme === "custom") setCustomTheme(localStorage.getItem("gnCustom") || "#fc2651");
    else setTheme(savedTheme);
    const savedDark = localStorage.getItem("gnDark");
    if (savedDark === "1") document.body.classList.add("dark-mode");
    else if (savedDark === "0") document.body.classList.remove("dark-mode");
  } catch(e) {}

  document.getElementById('settings').addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = "Settings";
    const swatchColors = { default:"#fc2651",ocean:"#3b82f6",emerald:"#10b981",violet:"#8b5cf6",sunset:"#f97316",rose:"#ec4899",cyan:"#06b6d4",amber:"#f59e0b",red:"#ef4444",lime:"#84cc16",teal:"#14b8a6",sky:"#0ea5e9",indigo:"#6366f1",fuchsia:"#d946ef",navy:"#172554" };
    let current = "default", currentCustom = "#fc2651";
    try { current = localStorage.getItem("gnTheme")||"default"; currentCustom = localStorage.getItem("gnCustom")||"#fc2651"; } catch(e) {}
    const swatches = THEMES.map(n =>
      `<button class="theme-swatch${n===current?' active':''}" data-theme-name="${n}" style="--sw:${swatchColors[n]}" title="${n.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+n.slice(1)}" onclick="setTheme('${n}')"></button>`
    ).join("");
    const customSwatch = `<label class="theme-swatch custom-swatch${current==='custom'?' active':''}" title="Custom color" style="--sw:${currentCustom};background:conic-gradient(from 90deg,#ef4444,#f59e0b,#10b981,#06b6d4,#3b82f6,#8b5cf6,#ec4899,#ef4444);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;"><input type="color" value="${currentCustom}" oninput="setCustomTheme(this.value)" style="opacity:0;width:150%;height:150%;cursor:pointer;border:0;padding:0;"></label>`;
    const pb = document.getElementById('popupBody');
    pb.innerHTML = `<button class="settings-button" onclick="darkMode()">Toggle Dark Mode</button>
    <div style="margin:1.25rem 0 .4rem;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;">Accent Theme</div>
    <div class="theme-grid">${swatches}${customSwatch}</div>
    <button class="settings-button" onclick="tabCloak()">Tab Cloak</button><br>`;
    pb.contentEditable = false;
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "flex";
  });

  function tabCloak() {
    closePopup();
    document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = "Tab Cloak";
    const pb = document.getElementById('popupBody');
    pb.innerHTML = `
      <label style="font-weight:bold;">Set Tab Title:</label><br>
      <input type="text" placeholder="Enter new tab name…" oninput="document.title=this.value||'gn-math'">
      <label style="font-weight:bold;">Set Tab Icon:</label><br>
      <input type="text" placeholder="Icon URL…" oninput="document.querySelector('link[rel~=icon]')&&(document.querySelector('link[rel~=icon]').href=this.value||'')">
    `;
    pb.contentEditable = false;
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "flex";
  }

  /* ================================================================
     POPUP HELPERS
  ================================================================ */
  function closePopup() {
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "none";
  }

  function showContact() {
    document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = "Contact";
    document.getElementById('popupBody').innerHTML = `<p>Discord: https://discord.gg/NAFw4ykZ7n</p><p>Email: gn.math.business@gmail.com</p>`;
    document.getElementById('popupBody').contentEditable = false;
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "flex";
  }

  function loadPrivacy() {
    document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = "Privacy Policy";
    document.getElementById('popupBody').innerHTML = `<div style="max-height:60vh;overflow-y:auto;">
      <h2>PRIVACY POLICY</h2><p>Last updated February 20, 2026</p>
      <p>This Privacy Notice for gn-math ("we," "us," or "our") describes how and why we might access, collect, store, use, and/or share your personal information when you use our services.</p>
      <p>Questions? Contact us at <a href="https://discord.gg/NAFw4ykZ7n">our Discord</a>.</p>
      <p>We do not process sensitive personal information. We do not collect information from third parties.</p>
    </div>`;
    document.getElementById('popupBody').contentEditable = false;
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "flex";
  }

  function loadDMCA() {
    document.getElementById('popupTitle').textContent = "DMCA";
    document.getElementById('popupBody').innerHTML = `<p>If you own a game listed here and want it removed:</p>
      <ol>
        <li><a href="https://discord.gg/D4c9VFYWyU" target="_blank">Join the Discord</a> and DM <strong>breadbb</strong> <strong>[INSTANT RESPONSE]</strong></li>
        <li>Email <a href="mailto:gn.math.business@gmail.com">gn.math.business@gmail.com</a> with subject <code>!DMCA</code> <strong>[DELAYED]</strong></li>
      </ol>
      <p>Include proof of ownership in your email.</p>`;
    document.getElementById('popupBody').contentEditable = false;
    document.getElementById('popupOverlay').style.display = "flex";
  }

  /* ================================================================
     DATA EXPORT / IMPORT (original gn-math, preserved)
  ================================================================ */
  function sanitizeData(obj, maxStr=1000, maxArr=10000) {
    if (typeof obj==='string') return obj.length>maxStr ? obj.slice(0,maxStr)+'…[truncated]' : obj;
    if (obj instanceof Uint8Array) return obj.length>maxArr ? `[Uint8Array too large (${obj.length} bytes)]` : obj;
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(i => sanitizeData(i,maxStr,maxArr));
    if (obj && typeof obj==='object') { const n={}; for (const k in obj) if (obj.hasOwnProperty(k)) n[k]=sanitizeData(obj[k],maxStr,maxArr); return n; }
    return obj;
  }

  async function saveData() {
    alert("This might take a while. Don't touch anything other than this OK button.");
    const result = { cookies: document.cookie, localStorage: {...localStorage}, sessionStorage: {...sessionStorage}, indexedDB: {}, caches: {} };
    const dbs = await indexedDB.databases();
    for (const dbInfo of dbs) {
      if (!dbInfo.name) continue;
      result.indexedDB[dbInfo.name] = {};
      await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const req = indexedDB.open(dbInfo.name, dbInfo.version);
        req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
        req.onsuccess = () => {
          const db = req.result;
          const stores = Array.from(db.objectStoreNames);
          if (!stores.length) { resolve(); return; }
          const tx = db.transaction(stores, "readonly");
          Promise.all(stores.map(sn => {
            result.indexedDB[dbInfo.name][sn] = [];
            const s = tx.objectStore(sn);
            return new Promise((res,rej) => {
              const r = s.getAll();
              r.onsuccess = () => { result.indexedDB[dbInfo.name][sn] = sanitizeData(r.result,1000,100); res(); };
              r.onerror   = () => rej(r.error);
            });
          })).then(resolve);
        };
      });
    }
    const cacheNames = await caches.keys();
    for (const cn of cacheNames) {
      const cache = await caches.open(cn);
      result.caches[cn] = [];
      for (const req of await cache.keys()) {
        const response = await cache.match(req);
        if (!response) continue;
        const ct = response.clone().headers.get('content-type') || '';
        let body;
        try {
          if (ct.includes('application/json')) body = await response.clone().json();
          else if (ct.includes('text')||ct.includes('javascript')) body = await response.clone().text();
          else body = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(await response.clone().arrayBuffer())));
        } catch { body = '[Unable to read]'; }
        result.caches[cn].push({ url: req.url, body, contentType: ct });
      }
    }
    alert("Done, wait for the download.");
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(result)], { type: "application/octet-stream" }));
    a.download = `${Date.now()}.data`;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
  }

  async function loadData(event) {
    const file = event.target.files[0]; if (!file) return;
    alert("This might take a while.");
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async e => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      if (data.cookies) data.cookies.split(';').forEach(c => document.cookie = c.trim());
      if (data.localStorage) for (const k in data.localStorage) localStorage.setItem(k, data.localStorage[k]);
      if (data.sessionStorage) for (const k in data.sessionStorage) sessionStorage.setItem(k, data.sessionStorage[k]);
      if (data.indexedDB) {
        for (const dbName in data.indexedDB) {
          const stores = data.indexedDB[dbName];
          await new Promise((res,rej) => {
            const req = indexedDB.open(dbName, 1);
            req.onupgradeneeded = e => {
              const db = e.target.result;
              for (const sn in stores) if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(sn)) db.createObjectStore(sn,{keyPath:'id',autoIncrement:true});
            };
            req.onsuccess = e => {
              const db = e.target.result;
              const tx = db.transaction(Object.keys(stores),'readwrite');
              tx.onerror = () => rej(tx.error);
              let pending = Object.keys(stores).length;
              for (const sn in stores) {
                const os = tx.objectStore(sn);
                os.clear().onsuccess = () => {
                  for (const item of stores[sn]) os.put(item);
                  if (--pending === 0) res();
                };
              }
            };
            req.onerror = () => rej(req.error);
          });
        }
      }
      if (data.caches) {
        for (const cn in data.caches) {
          const cache = await caches.open(cn);
          await cache.keys().then(keys => Promise.all(keys.map(k => cache.delete(k))));
          for (const entry of data.caches[cn]) {
            let body;
            if (entry.contentType.includes('application/json')) body = JSON.stringify(entry.body);
            else if (entry.contentType.includes('text')||entry.contentType.includes('javascript')) body = entry.body;
            else { const b=atob(entry.body); const a=new Uint8Array(b.length); for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++) a[i]=b.charCodeAt(i); body=a.buffer; }
            await cache.put(entry.url, new Response(body, { headers: new Headers({'content-type':entry.contentType}) }));
          }
        }
      }
      alert("Data loaded.");
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }

  /* ================================================================
     BOOT
  ================================================================ */
  listZones();

  HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.toDataURL = function() { return ""; };
  </script>
